video_summary.overall_goal: Create a new note with title and content, then return to notes list
video_summary.description: User opens Simple Notes app, navigates to new note creation screen, types title 'Abc', types content 'Xyz', returns to list view, and interacts with note selection.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Main notes list screen with two existing notes: 'Unaid' and 'Ganadi', both dated 13.03.2025
steps.system_response: List view displayed with existing notes
steps.intent_task: View existing notes in the app

steps.what_screen_is_visible: New Note screen with 'Title' field (contains 'Abc') and 'Content' field (empty), keyboard visible at bottom showing QWERTY layout
steps.system_response: Navigated to new note screen, keyboard opened for title input
steps.navigation_change: from list to new note creation
steps.visual_feedback: Keyboard displayed, title field focused and contains text
steps.intent_task: Create new note and enter title

steps.what_screen_is_visible: New Note screen with 'Title' field showing 'Abc' and 'Content' field showing 'Xyz', keyboard still visible at bottom
steps.system_response: Content field focused and user typed 'Xyz'
steps.visual_feedback: Content field now contains text, cursor positioned in content area
steps.intent_task: Enter content for the new note

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Notes list view returned, showing selection mode with '1 selected' at top in red/pink header, 'Abc' note is highlighted/selected, other notes ('Unaid', 'Ganadi') visible but not selected
steps.target_element: Back button from new note screen
steps.system_response: Returned to list view, new note 'Abc' appears in list and is selected
steps.navigation_change: from new note creation to notes list
steps.visual_feedback: Selection mode activated (red header), 'Abc' note highlighted with checkbox checked
steps.intent_task: Return to notes list after creating note

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Notes list view returned to normal mode (no selection), showing three notes: 'Unaid', 'Ganadi', and 'Abc' (the newly created note, positioned at top left)
steps.target_element: X button or blank area to deselect
steps.system_response: Selection mode exited, normal list view displayed
steps.visual_feedback: Header returned to purple/dark color, no selection highlight, all notes visible normally
steps.intent_task: Exit selection mode and view all notes

overall_flow: App launches showing notes list with existing notes
User taps to create new note, navigates to creation screen
User enters title 'Abc' in title field
User enters content 'Xyz' in content field
User presses back to return to notes list
New note 'Abc' appears in list and is automatically selected
User deselects the note to return to normal list view
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: App displays notes list with existing notes 'Unaid' and 'Ganadi'
Step 2: User navigates to new note creation and types title 'Abc'
Step 3: User types content 'Xyz' in the content field
Step 4: User returns to list view where newly created 'Abc' note is selected
Step 5: User deselects the note to return to normal list view with all three notes visible
